duaAfterAthan.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duaAfterAthan.english: O Allah! Lord of this perfect call (perfect by not ascribing partners to You) and of the regular prayer which is going to be established, give Muhammad the right of intercession and illustriousness, and resurrect him to the best and the highest place in Paradise that You promised him.

iftarDua.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
iftarDua.english: Thirst has gone, the arteries are moist, and the reward is sure, if Allah wills.

suhoorReminder.english: Take Suhur as there is a blessing in it.

asr.english: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.

maghrib.english: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening.

isha.english: Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds.

jumuah.arabic: فَٱسْعَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلْبَيْعَ
jumuah.english: Proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade.

tahajjud.english: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness.

duha.arabic: وَيُجْزِئُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ رَكْعَتَانِ يَرْكَعُهُمَا مِنَ الضُّحَى
duha.english: Two rak'ahs which one prays in the forenoon will suffice.
